summary: Vista Energy, S.A.B. de C.V., a Mexican oil and gas issuer listed on the NYSE and BMV, filed a Form 6-K announcing only a scheduling change: its Q3 2026 results webcast moved to 9:00 am Mexico City time (11:00 am ET) on Thursday, October 29, 2026, from the originally planned 8:00 am slot. No transaction, stake, price, recommendation or advisor is disclosed. The filing is a routine investor-communications notice, not a special situation; no deal terms, structural or regulatory mechanics apply, and there is no arbitrage angle to monitor.
